chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari narrated to me from Abi Sa'id Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Zakariyya Al-'Adwi Al-Basri, who said: 'Amr ibn Mukhtar narrated to us, who said: Isḥaq ibn Bishr narrated to us from Al-Qawwam, the freedman of Quraysh, who said: I heard my master 'Amr ibn Hubayrah say:
I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) with Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn on his lap. He would kiss one, then the other, and say to Al-Husayn: 'Woe to those who will kill you.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to Imam Husayn while holding him on his lap?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this narration emphasizes the intimate bond between the Prophet and the Imams while foretelling the tragedy of Karbala through the specific warning of 'woe' (al-wail) for their killers. This prophetic declaration serves as a foundational proof for the Ahl al-Bayt's status and the inevitability of their martyrdom, linking the personal affection of the Prophet to the cosmic significance of Husayn's sacrifice.
